source: Official alignment for five Expedition finals (docs/BOSS-MECHANICS.md). Skills, casts and area shapes are the client's own. Phase timing and named mechanics come from official MapEvent HpRemaining orbs (Easy 70/30) plus 2025-2026 clear videos and guides (YouTube ids in that doc). Invented generic adds, 40%/20% fury/enrage and 'longest-cast as a repeating slam' are removed for these bosses. Frenzy at 5:00 on Normal (guides / aion2data; damage x2) and 4:00 on Hard (existing global hard-mode rule). Easy has no frenzy. Unique mechanics the engine cannot yet run (pillar cover, fire-wall gaps, soak split, jump-rope rings, clone intercept, orb redirect) are notices only.
